traps.description: an unsaved shortcut (a symbolic link, the filesystem kind, not a menu command) pointing at a real folder inside the project -- left uncommitted
traps.blocker: a pause fingerprint that followed folder shortcuts

assertion.must: a symbolic link whose target resolves to a real directory inside the project, left uncommitted

traps.description: two shortcuts (symbolic links) that point at each other, forming a loop
traps.note: no historical blocker names this trap specifically -- it is a robustness net against a hang or an unhandled crash when a directory walk meets a symlink cycle

assertion.must: loop-a and loop-b are symbolic links that point at each other

traps.description: two real files in different directories whose archive-relative names collide only by letter case
traps.blocker: two archive names differing only by letter case
traps.note: built as two files in different directories, never as same-directory siblings -- a case-insensitive volume (the macOS default) silently aliases same-directory siblings differing only by case, so the trap would not exist; this different-directory shape is what the real bug actually was

assertion.must: both paths exist as distinct regular files whose archive-relative names are identical once lowercased

traps.description: a subdirectory that is its own git repository, with its own committed file, left uncommitted in the outer project
traps.blocker: a pause fingerprint that followed folder shortcuts
traps.note: the same fix covers this trap per that commit's own message; its behaviour at survey time is genuinely unexplored -- no existing code detects a nested repository

assertion.must: path/.git is a real directory, path has its own commit, and the outer repository's git status --porcelain reports path as untracked

traps.description: a real source file reachable only through a directory chain long enough to exceed the forty-character canonical lineage cap (a limit on how long a specification item's identity can be)
traps.note: a genuine 2026-09-21 fix (commit 1c3a1299, specPublicPathLineage) but not one of the six blockers the decision record names -- a bonus regression check

assertion.must: specPublicPathLineage(path) falls back to a short digest ID because the normalized lineage exceeds 40 canonical characters

traps.description: a territory snapshot (the colony's saved map of the codebase) recorded far enough behind the project's own commits to classify as stale
traps.blocker: a folder missing from a write allowlist
traps.note: the stale map is what forces the territory refresh that hits the missing write-allowlist entry

assertion.must: classifySurveyFreshness(repo, now) reports Freshness Stale with source_revision_changed and source_revision_expired among its reason codes

traps.description: a planning run parked mid-flight against an approved specification (the owner-approved contract for the work) that the owner then corrects, superseding it
traps.blocker: a planning run pinned to a superseded specification
traps.note: built via the runtime's own specification writers (createSpecificationDraft/approveSpecification/reviseSpecification), never a hand-typed stage-state.json -- that file's own format is self-authenticating (it carries a real approval receipt hash), so a fabricated shape would either be rejected outright or silently fail to trip the real refusal this trap exists to prove

assertion.must: planningRunIsSuperseded is true for the parked run's own stage-state.json against the specification's current approved revision, and the run is genuinely awaiting a worker

traps.description: junk left behind in the colony's own failure log and its steering-signal log -- entries the colony has not yet acknowledged or cleaned up
traps.blocker: a status card advising a menu command that does not exist

assertion.must: midden.json has at least one entry with acknowledged false, and pheromones.json has at least one signal marked active whose expiry date has already passed

traps.description: uncommitted edits to a tracked file and at least one untracked file, left in place at the end of the build
traps.blocker: a pause fingerprint that followed folder shortcuts

assertion.must: git status --porcelain is non-empty and includes both a modified tracked path and an untracked path
